description: Replace ONE block of the site without touching the rest of the page (the rest stays byte for byte). Use it instead of generate_ai_site when something specific must change — a regeneration is costly and can lose content. First list_site_blocks. Pass the FULL new <section>...</section>: the same outer tag with all its attributes, every data-quinta* attribute in place, no links/images/fields lost, WITHOUT <script> and without links to new outside domains. The edit is checked before it is written: if it fails, it is NOT written, and you get the reason.
name: edit_site_block
